name: bld4_compact_mutual_isometric_embeddings_isometryEquiv
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X) (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g) : Nonempty (X ≃ᵢ Y)
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X) (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g), Nonempty (X ≃ᵢ Y)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld3_compact_mutual_expanding_isometry: isometries are expanding (dist equality), so the cited theorem gives that f is a surjective isometry; an isometry is injective, so Equiv.ofBijective f packaged with hf is the IsometryEquiv.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] {Y : Type u_2} [inst_2 : MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → X), Isometry f → Isometry g → Nonempty (X ≃ᵢ Y)
